candidates.change_summary: Delete the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds.
Replace the withdraw amount with 0 so withdrawAll transfers nothing instead of the full balance.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone (not just the owner) can call withdrawAll and drain the contract.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw(uint) sends no ether, leaving the contract balance unchanged.
Remove the onlyOwner guard from withdraw(uint) so any caller can withdraw an arbitrary value.
Transfer the contract's entire balance instead of the requested _value, so a partial withdraw transfers a different amount.
Invert the require check in onlyOwner so withdraw reverts for the owner and succeeds only for non-owners.
Remove the revert on failed call, so a failing sendMoney call no longer reverts and silently completes.
Invert the success check so sendMoney reverts whenever the call succeeds and completes when it fails.
Send the funds to the caller (msg.sender) instead of the _target address.
Remove the onlyOwner guard so any address can call sendMoney.
Delete the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds out.
Withdraw only one less wei than the full balance, leaving 1 wei in the contract.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any address can drain the contract.
Delete the require check in onlyOwner so withdrawAll succeeds for non-owners.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners (never the owner) can execute withdrawAll.
